The patient's own childhood sexual abuse is coded with the wrong assertion (present instead of historical) and at insufficient specificity (generic 'Victim of sexual abuse' rather than 'Victim of child sexual abuse'). All other coded concepts are confirmed correct; the unreliable lookup results for 394687007 and 24921000000109 were resolved via search and are legitimate. Note: the CMHT referral is coded as 'awaiting' allocation — if the referral has not yet been formally sent, the assertion may warrant review, but the note supports coding it as present.
